bullets.text: AI Roadshows for Accountants - Join **Sage**'s upcoming events to explore practical AI adoption strategies tailored for accounting practices.
Embrace AI or Fall Behind - With **Making Tax Digital** launching soon, accountants must adapt to AI or risk being overwhelmed.
Three Archetypes of AI Adoption - **Sage** identifies Strategic Adopters, Cautious Observers, and Digital Traditionalists among accounting firms.
